title.zh: 三件你现在就能核验的事
title.en: Three things you can check today

1b.zh: 现有目录指进来就能用，Markdown 还是你原来的那些文件；记录与作品都在自己的文件夹里，想走随时原样带走。
1b.en: Point it at your folder and go — the Markdown stays your own files. Entries and works live in that folder, ready to take with you as they are.

2b.zh: 当前阶段的能力完整可用；AI 用量走你自己的 Key，模型账单落在你的账户上，不经我们。
2b.en: Everything in the current stage is usable; AI usage runs on your own key, billed to your account, never through us.

3b.zh: 取用别人整理好的结构与能力，装好就能用在你自己的作品里。
3b.en: Take a structure or an ability someone else put up, install it, and use it inside your own work.
